static_traits.name: An Peiqi
static_traits.social_status: has a few friends to discuss Average topics with, but has not yet discussed cognitive distortion issues with them
static_traits.medical_history: deny past similar psychological problems and treatment history; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, strong logic, highly cooperative, capable of self-Reflection; often uses rule-based language like 'must/should', harsh self-evaluation; tense mood but Positive attitude, willing to change

basic_info.main_problem: in recent months, 'labeling/mislabeling' and black-and-white thinking have appeared around diet and daily routine: once I have not perfectly followed the healthy diet or daily plan, I conclude 'the whole day is a failure/wasted', leading to increased stress and Impaired self-esteem, further affecting Work performance, social interaction, sleep and self-care.
basic_info.core_demands: when realizing these cognitive distortions are affecting daily functioning, bringing unnecessary stress and harming self-image, hoping to Learning to identify, challenge and reframe black-and-white thoughts through counseling, reducing stress and improving overall functioning and self-evaluation.

special_situations.event: after a dietary deviation (e.g. healthy breakfast in the morning, chips in the afternoon), evaluating the whole day as a failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I have not perfectly followed the healthy eating plan, the day counts as a complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: setting and strictly following rigid rules, using self-blame and harsh inner dialogue to 'urge' oneself on, negating any positive part of the day
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up again; today is completely ruined

special_situations.event: when daily routine deviates (not yet fully executed as planned)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: must complete all steps strictly as planned, otherwiseI am just a failure/not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: excessive Self-monitoring, Repressing relaxation and social plans to avoid deviation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not follow the plan,I am not good enough

special_situations.event: when reviewing the day's performance before sleep at night, only focusing on what was not yet done while ignoring what was done well
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: need to constantly Reflect on and watch errors closely to prevent future problems
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated rumination, worry, and self-criticism, continuously focusing on negative details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: if I do not think these problems through, tomorrow will be worse

special_situations.event: On the day, there is partial progress in healthy eating or completing plans, along with small deviations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: any deviation will Undoing all positive efforts, positive parts do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: listing and magnifying errors, negating positive behaviors to 'warn' oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: the morning's efforts do not count

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain stable self-worth and recognition through self-discipline and perfect performance
core_conflict.fear: fear of being seen as a failure or not good enough, thus being negated
defense_goal: Maintaining control and a sense of safety through strict rules and perfectionism
avoiding further mistakes and being negated through self-criticism

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about minor deviations in diet or daily routine, or when asked what was done well that day
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats minor deviations as total failure, worries about being judged, tends to ignore the positive
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: reviewing the day in a self-blaming tone, magnifying errors, lowering self-worth, weakening or not mentioning positive behaviors. Rigid wording, emphasizing failure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or setting standards and goals related to health and routine
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treats external health standards as absolute truth, ignoring individual differences and situational flexibility
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using absolutist phrasing like 'should/must', emphasizing rule-following over experience, avoiding discussion of personal needs and preferences.

manifestations: Constrains daily life with rigid self-rules, lacking flexibility of choice
Equates occasional deviations with losing control and failure
outcomes: Declining life resilience and harsher self-blame

manifestations: Worries about diet and routines affect social interaction and the ability to connect
outcomes: reduced interpersonal contact,Increased subjective sense of isolation
Damaged self-image and more negative emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: treating healthy-eating standards as inviolable absolute rules
treating one deviation as unacceptable, thus negating the whole day

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Highly alert to tiny deviations, ruminating repeatedly
Strong self-criticism; hard to stop negative review before sleep
Reduces interaction and expression for fear of others' judgment

positive_force: Actively seeks help, positive attitude, willing to change thinking patterns
Has a certain foundation of healthy habits (for example, can choose a healthy breakfast)
able to identify and describe specific trigger situations and automatic thoughts under Guidance
having some Social support (several friends to discuss Average topics with)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as black-and-white thinking and mental filtering
catastrophic/blanket interpretation of deviations causing stress and Sleep impaired
Reduced socializing due to worry about self-performance, further weakening support

target_behavior.function: maintaining a sense of control through self-punishment and vigilance, preventing future mistakes
target_behavior.consequence: Rising stress,Sleep impaired,Work and social life affected, declining self-image

attention focused on the details of 'not yet done'
